name: NitroFusionPublish
description: Publishes a Fusion configuration to the Nitro registry.
author: ChilliCream

inputs.name: tag
inputs.label: Tag
inputs.helpMarkDown: The tag of the source schema version.

inputs.name: apiKey
inputs.label: API key
inputs.helpMarkDown: API key for authentication. Use a secret pipeline variable: `$(NITRO_API_KEY)`.

inputs.name: sourceSchemas
inputs.label: Source schemas
inputs.helpMarkDown: Source schemas to include in the composition (one per line, e.g. `example` or `example@1.0.0`). If no version is specified, the tag value is used.

inputs.name: legacyV1Archive
inputs.label: Legacy v1 archive
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to a Fusion v1 archive file.

inputs.name: force
inputs.label: Force
inputs.helpMarkDown: Continue publishing even if breaking changes or validation errors are detected.

inputs.name: waitForApproval
inputs.label: Wait for approval
inputs.helpMarkDown: Require approval in the Nitro UI to continue publishing when breaking changes or validation errors are detected.

inputs.name: cloudUrl
inputs.label: Cloud URL
inputs.helpMarkDown: The URL of the Nitro registry.
